body.statement: Let a random criterion on a compact parameter space converge uniformly in probability to a continuous population criterion having a unique minimizer.  Every exact measurable global minimizer of the random criterion converges in probability to that population minimizer.

source.verbatim_statement: Unique maximization, compactness, continuity, and uniform convergence in probability imply that the extremum estimator converges in probability to the unique maximizer.

attestation.note: Verified against the primary Handbook chapter scan, Theorem 2.1 on printed page 2121; the node uses the equivalent minimization form.
